title: Retrospective study on the treatment of patients in specialized outpatient pain therapy
summary: Based on existing data from clinical documentation, the project aims to determine the extent to which the severity of the disease and the course of the disease in patients undergoing specialized outpatient pain therapy have changed over the past 10 years. Furthermore, based on the data, a prototype of a risk score for the development of chronic pain after surgery will be developed as a basis for an improved preventive pain therapy.
